key_provisions_or_claims: Calls for a common EU position ensuring meaningful human control over critical functions of weapon systems
Urges start of international negotiations on a legally binding instrument prohibiting lethal autonomous weapon systems
Stresses preventing development and production of LAWS lacking human control over target selection and engagement
Defines LAWS as systems without meaningful human control; excludes remotely operated systems and defensive systems
Links EU defence funding (European Defence Fund) to excluding LAWS development
annotation.summary_en: European Parliament resolution of 12 September 2018 (published in OJ C 433, 2019) on autonomous weapon systems. It calls for a common EU position ensuring meaningful human control over critical functions and urges international negotiations toward a legally binding ban on lethal autonomous weapon systems.
